title: LeaverReviewOpen
description: Sent by the control plane's leaver workflow, signed with the tenant's service secret: open the review of a leaver's personal knowledge layer and freeze it. Repeating an id is safe.

id.description: The leaver workflow's id and run id: unique per leaving, stable across retries.

deciders.description: Candidate deciders in order of preference: the manager, then instance sponsors. The first who is not the leaver decides; with none, the tenant's privacy officers do.
